survey: Folding camp chair, seen in three-quarter view from slightly above, turned so it faces toward the lower right. We see its left side and its front. The backrest is a green canvas panel between two vertical grey posts. The left post continues down as the back-left leg, with its foot at the far left. The seat is a green sling seen from above, with its front edge sloping slightly down toward the left (nearer) corner. Each armrest pad runs from the backrest to a short post that drops to a bracket at the front corner of the seat. Both pads slant down toward the front, as parallel receding edges should. The two front legs form an X with a central hub, and their feet stand on the floor with the near-left foot lowest. The back-left foot is higher and further left, which fits the depth direction set by the armrests. The floor is seen from above and has a cast shadow to the left. The camera, seat, armrests, backrest and feet all agree on one viewpoint.

errors.where: Under the right half of the seat, behind the front X-brace
errors.what: The back-right leg and its foot are missing. The front feet and the back-left foot set up a footprint, and the fourth foot should sit up and to the left of the front-right foot, around the space just above the X hub. That space shows only open floor, so the chair stands on three visible feet and the footprint does not close.

fix: Show the back-right leg of the folding chair: a grey tube running down from the right rear corner of the seat, seen partly behind the front X-brace. Its rubber foot should rest on the floor up and to the left of the front-right foot, so all four feet form one rectangle on the same ground plane.
